$comment: Consumed by scripts/ci/check_gate_coverage.py. A gate listed here must exist, be invoked by `make check`, be reachable from CI, carry a falsifiability injection, and declare its complete eligible file class. U-30: this file was previously read by nothing.

python_matrix.$comment: Z-12. NORM-039 requires the golden vectors to be exercised on Python 3.9 AND the current CI Python. D-12 sets the >=3.9 floor; docs/development/CI_INVENTORY.md P-03/P-07 name 3.12 as the current supported version. check_gate_coverage.py asserts the workflow really declares this matrix and really runs the certification command in every lane - a lane that boots an interpreter and never executes the vectors closes nothing. W1-B: the production tests join the matrix, because a production implementation proven on one interpreter is not proven.

check-scope.falsification: D-96 product code with no verified freeze set

check-docs.falsification: C-05 forbidden claim in a non-exempt document

check-freeze.falsification: D-68 frozen artifact modified after manifest
check-freeze.eligible_may_be_empty_reason: No freeze set is declared during the candidate phase. The gate passes explicitly on an empty freeze/ directory and becomes load-bearing the moment W1_CORE.sha256 is written. Stated rather than excused (GOV-001).

check-vectors.falsification: NORM-039 golden vector mutated by one byte

check-vectors-negative.falsification: Z-14 verifier accepts a corrupted artifact

check-python-floor.falsification: D-12 production code uses an API newer than the runtime floor

check-privacy.falsification: D-90 an operator identifier reaches the publication surface

check-docs-truth.falsification: C-06 competitive framing naming an external project

check-current-state.falsification: D-89 the status registry claims a capability whose evidence is absent

check-packaging.falsification: D-86 the rpm spec declares a build dependency the release builder cannot resolve

check-storage-vocabulary.falsification: D-114 a published document reports a storage device type of ROTATIONAL

check-public-claims.falsification: D-88 the README version badge disagrees with VERSION

check-licensing.falsification: D-90 an unregistered framework pack enters the tree

check-native-catalog.falsification: D-111 a production module is named after a framework provider

unpublished_paths.$comment: Declared gate scopes that are absent by design in a public checkout. check_gate_coverage.py must not call these a stale declaration: the path is real and in scope where the gate can act on it. Anything NOT listed here that matches no file is still a stale declaration.

private_only_gates.$comment: Gates that read material outside the repository and therefore cannot run in public CI. They are NOT in `make check` and that is deliberate, not a coverage gap. Listed so the omission is visible rather than silent.
private_only_gates.check-provider-alignment: reads the private provider licensing registry, located by the ISEDRAF_PROVIDER_REGISTRY environment variable and absent on a runner; skips with an explicit message and never reports a pass it did not earn

gates_outside_make_check.$comment: Every check_* script that `make check` does NOT aggregate, with the reason and the thing that actually runs it. This section exists because the coverage gate used to verify only what was DECLARED: a new gate nobody listed was invisible to it, and passed coverage by not being mentioned. The gate now reconciles this file against scripts/ci/ and fails on any check_* script that appears in neither list, so a gate cannot be added without being accounted for, and one cannot be quietly orphaned.

check-gate-coverage.reason: the meta-gate. It verifies the others, so aggregating it into the target it verifies would make it report on itself.

check-sbom.reason: needs built packages and rpm's own recorded per-file digests; there is nothing to cross-check before a build.

check-package-payload.reason: compares the built deb and rpm payloads against each other; requires both artifacts.

check-reproducible.reason: builds twice and compares bytes; too slow for the pre-commit path and meaningless without a build.

check-deb-ordering.reason: reads the member order inside a built .deb archive.

check-attestation-falsifiable.reason: requires a real attestation from the release workflow; it cannot be produced or verified on a workstation.

check-provider-alignment.reason: private: reads the provider licensing registry located by ISEDRAF_PROVIDER_REGISTRY, which is absent on a runner. Also recorded in private_only_gates.
